data.one_liner: Generates compact, sortable, URL‑safe 20‑character IDs based on MongoDB ObjectID algorithm.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart implementation of the Xid algorithm, creating 12‑byte (96‑bit) identifiers encoded in base32 hex. The IDs are k‑ordered, include a timestamp, and require no configuration or central server.
use_when: You need short, sortable IDs without external services
You want IDs that embed time and are URL‑safe
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution that works on all platforms
avoid_when: You need cryptographically secure random IDs
You require UUID format or compatibility with existing UUID tooling
weaknesses: Not a standard UUID, may not interoperate with UUID‑only systems

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard 128‑bit UUIDs with wide ecosystem support and familiar format
